title: We Have All the Cards: Securing Agent Cards at the Operational Trust Boundary of the Agent2Agent Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2611.18887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agent interoperability protocols enable orchestrators to discover and invoke external agents using machine-readable metadata. In the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, Agent Cards contain attacker-controllable natural-language fields that may influence agent selection before a provider is invoked, creating a pre-invocation trust problem. We characterize this discovery-time attack surface through a taxonomy of ten Agent Card manipulation attacks and present SECCARD, a layered validation framework combining protocol checks, deterministic analysis, and LLM-based semantic reasoning. We measure the emerging public A2A ecosystem by probing 36.1 million Internet domains and collecting 310 deployed Agent Cards. Two annotators independently label the corpus with 96.8% agreement. We then construct a 660-card real-card perturbation benchmark with matched benign controls and a 260-card synthetic adversarial benchmark spanning all ten attack categories

translated_title: 我们手握所有卡片：在Agent2Agent协议运行信任边界处保障Agent Card（代理卡）安全
translated_abstract: AI代理互操作协议使编排器能够利用机器可读元数据来发现和调用外部代理。在Agent2Agent（A2A）协议中，Agent Card包含攻击者可控的自然语言字段，这些字段可能在调用提供方之前影响代理的选择，由此产生了“调用前信任”问题。我们通过一个涵盖十种Agent Card操纵攻击的分类体系刻画了这一发现时攻击面，并提出了SECCARD——一个融合协议检查、确定性分析和基于LLM语义推理的分层验证框架。我们通过探测3610万个互联网域名并收集310张已部署的Agent Card，对新兴的公共A2A生态系统进行了测量。两名标注者独立对该语料库进行标注，一致性达96.8%。随后，我们构建了一个包含660张卡片的真实卡片扰动基准（配有匹配的良性对照组），以及一个覆盖全部十种攻击类别、包含260张卡片的合成对抗基准。
tldr: 该论文通过刻画A2A协议中Agent Card的十种操纵攻击并提出结合协议检查、确定性分析与LLM语义推理的分层验证框架SECCARD，同时构建大规模真实与对抗基准，解决了代理发现阶段的调用前信任问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SECCARD, a layered validation framework combining protocol checks, deterministic analysis, and LLM-based semantic reasoning to secure Agent Cards at the A2A protocol's discovery stage, characterized by a taxonomy of ten manipulation attacks and validated on large-scale real-world and adversarial benchmarks.
